meta_description:
From becoming one of Bollywood’s most recognisable leading ladies to finding her footing in a new chapter of life, Harper’s Bazaar India’s August-September cover star Kiara Advani (@kiaraaliaadvani) has learnt that evolution doesn’t always mean starting over. She is embracing the uncertainty of what comes next, taking on challenging roles, navigating motherhood and allowing herself the freedom to not have every detail mapped out. “An actor’s job for me is to surprise people, and sometimes surprise yourself. I don’t want to build a box around myself,” Advani shares.

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.
